summary.text: Tara Reardon is a Democratic state senator and attorney from New Hampshire who has represented District 15 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Reardon earned an applied science degree from Westbrook College, a bachelor's degree from Franklin Pierce College, and a law degree from the University of New Hampshire, Franklin Pierce School of Law.
Her career experience includes working as an attorney and as a vice president of external relations.
Reardon assumed office in the State Senate on December 4, 2024, and in the 2025-2026 session serves on the Commerce, Senate Executive Departments and Administration, and Senate Judiciary committees.
